items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Mr Root came and had a ball.

ctx.x: Robert La Gamma invited us to Thanksgiving dinner along with Monsieur and Madame Pango the 25th.

The 26th, we were invited to the residence of Mr. and Mrs.Root, the American Ambassador, who was giving a luncheon in our honour. This was a different reception from the kick in the ass I got when I was in Egypt, and couldn't even get a look at the Ambassador when the fellows I was with and myself needed help. We gave a concert that night at the cultural center in Treichville and Mr Root came and had a ball.

We were invited for lunch with Mr. Pango at the house of an African Notable in Grand Bassam. We were delighted to be invited in an African family, have the chance to see their house, their way of living, and to be able to eat African food.
